scripts.deploy: scp index.html qx-web:/tmp/official-website-index.html && ssh qx-web 'sudo cp /tmp/official-website-index.html /www/official-website/index.html && rm /tmp/official-website-index.html'
scripts.run: ssh qx-web 'sudo pm2 delete all 2>/dev/null; sudo pm2 start npx --name static-web -- serve /www/official-website -l 80'
